utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — if you can point me to Rosa or let me know the time, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa’s the one coordinating it, and I’ll send you the time as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll check our supplies and let you know what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great—just to confirm, you’ll let me know what we can spare and what we’re short on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll confirm what we can spare and flag anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m on it and ready to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — please help me review the list and note any supplies we still need. If you hear of any homes needing repairs, send them my way and I’ll add them right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll review the list, note any missing supplies, and send you any homes that need repairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. Let’s start with the repair list and sort it by priority, nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—let’s sort the repair list by priority first, and then I can double-check the time, drop-off spot, and what people should bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. I’ll keep the list handy, and once you confirm the time and drop-off spot, we can share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Late Saturday morning sounds good to me — I’ll keep spreading the word and signing folks up. Thanks, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — thanks, Mara. The repair drive is at the community center on Maple, just past the library; take Oak over and turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and signing folks up for late Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in this week—just give me the quickest job and I’ll take it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s great — sorting donations is probably the quickest thing, and I still need the time and place again so I don’t mix them up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—just send me the time and place, and I’ll do the donation sorting.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, but I think we should confirm the start time and who’s bringing what. If you want, I can help pin down the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m out running errands, so I can pass along the start time and who’s bringing what once we’ve got it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — I’ll check on the remaining details, especially the drop-off spot and any tools or parts people should bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—I'll bring the gloves and flashlight, and I’ll check in with Ira when I get there. What should I tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Start with the gloves and flashlight, then check what supplies we still need and let Ira know the time and place again.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m mostly trying to pin down the timing and who’s coordinating it, so I know when to expect everyone and who to check with.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: The time’s still set, and I’m helping coordinate it — I can fill you in on the latest and who to check with. If you’re coming, gloves and any extra tools would be great.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — that helps. I’m mainly checking who I should coordinate with and whether the timing is still firm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—do you know what they’re fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the first item yet, but I’m going to ask around and see what’s up. If I hear anything solid, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—just let me know when you hear the first repair they're starting with.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still gathering a few details, but I should have an update soon. If you hear of any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and send any homes your way. Just let me know when you have the update, and I’ll fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I really appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you’re coming by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Noah — I’ll let you know when I’m on my way with the wrench and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for you and the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — if you know any homes that need help, send them my way and I’ll add them to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll ask around and send you any homes I hear about. If I learn anything about the schedule or supplies, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate that. I’ll keep the list updated and make sure everyone hears about any schedule or supply changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m available this week — just give me the quickest task.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — please take the Maple house with the leaking porch. I’ll send you the details and parts list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the details and parts list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — I can bring the wrench and screwdriver for the repair drive. Just let me know when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Gus — I’m still piecing together the details, so what are they fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet, but I can check in and see what needs fixing first. Just give me a holler when you’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any update yet, Eli? I’m out running errands, so I can pass it along if needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — if you can, please pass along the list and I’ll sort the repairs by priority when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll pass along the list while I’m out and check back when I’m back. Thanks, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still able to help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — I’m still able to help. What time works best around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just checking, can you do early evening on Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll check our supplies and let you know what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. I’m mostly trying to pin down the timing and who’s coordinating, so if you hear anything solid, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s coordinating it, and Vik’s spreading the word — I’ll check our supplies and update you as soon as I know what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’ll be waiting on the porch when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’ll head over shortly and check in when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll be right here on the porch when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m on it, and I’ll invite a few neighbors over this afternoon. I’ll swing by with any help I round up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — the repair drive is at the community center on Maple, just past the library. Take Oak over and turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll head to the community center on Maple, past the library, and turn right at the park. I’ll bring whoever I can round up for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll bring gloves and a flashlight. Anything else you need me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A few rags and some screwdrivers would be great if you can swing it, thanks!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll bring a few rags and some screwdrivers too. See you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll start reaching out to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll keep asking around and pass along anything solid as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’ll do the same and keep people posted once I get Quinn’s details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet—I’m still gathering a few details, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have an update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — thanks, Rey. I’ll wait for your update and see what still needs to be brought.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate it. I’m still checking what’s needed, and I’ll pass along the list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — if you can confirm the time, what still needs doing, and what folks should bring, I’ll double-check it all.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think we still need a few tools and maybe more hands to sort donations. I’m in, I just need the time and place again so I don’t mix them up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — it’s at the community center on Maple, just past the library, and the time hasn’t changed. We still need a few more hands, some tools, and gloves if people can bring them.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
